known.title: Preserve board reads when forge.toml is absent

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - an agent runs `forge board --json` or `forge next --json` in an existing repository before adoption.
This unconditional call invokes `repo.is_prototype(top)` without a configuration, which calls `repo.config(top)` and refuses when forge.toml is absent (repo.py:617–621, 709–715). Consequently, the entire board now fails instead of returning its existing facts. The board already handles this valid state through `_report_config` (nextstep.py:477–482). Pass its existing `configuration(top)` result into `signoff` so non-prototype repositories retain that behavior.
